name: f4-re-mcp
description: Local lookup tools over verified Fallout 4 engine reverse-engineering facts: symbols, address-library mappings, name-confidence audit trail, and vtable audits.
long_description: Gives an AI assistant direct, structured access to this workspace's F4 engine RE research instead of guessing symbol names, offsets, or OG/AE addresses from memory - the exact failure mode that's caused real bugs before (a wrong RTTI name trusted, a hook landing in .rdata instead of .text, OG vs AE address-space mixups). Backed by a pre-built local SQLite index of the Address Library .bin files, the OG symbol dump, the OG/AE cross-mapping, and the confirmed/reverted name-correction and vtable-audit CSVs. Entirely local - no network access, no data leaves this machine.

db_path.title: Path to re-index.sqlite
db_path.description: Absolute path to the pre-built RE index database (built via 'npm run build-index'). The bundle doesn't ship the ~1GB index itself.

root.title: Path to the ReverseEngineering directory
root.description: Absolute path to the ReverseEngineering directory that holds the searchable findings docs (03-FINDINGS.md, 05-LABEL-RECOVERY.md, 06-FUNCTION-INDEX.md, 07-DECOMPILE-CANDIDATES.md). The bundle doesn't ship them, so search_findings is empty without this.

tools.name: lookup_by_address
tools.description: Resolve a hex address (VA or RVA) to its symbol name, signature, and Address Library id.

tools.name: check_name_confidence
tools.description: Check whether a symbol name is trustworthy before hooking it, via the confirmed-correction / reverted / disagreement audit trail.

tools.name: get_vtable_slots
tools.description: Get CommonLibF4's expected vtable layout for a class, joined with the live Ghidra audit verdict.

tools.name: map_og_ae
tools.description: Map a function between Old-Gen (1.10.163) and AE (1.11.221) address spaces.

tools.name: search_findings
tools.description: Keyword search over the RE findings docs (struct offsets, bug write-ups).
